// Fixture: a COSMETIC .Pass.String() display/serialization site that MUST be
// EXCLUDED from the completeness guard's discovery scope (SPEC-041 CLM-022). It
// carries no gate-semantic decision — it only renders a label — so the bounded
// guard must NOT discover it (the negative case for the bounded-scope
// assertion). .go.txt so it is not compiled; the guard scans it as a fixture.
package fixture

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/bmanson/backstop-core/pkg/check"
)

// renderLabel is a cosmetic display site: it stringifies the pass for a log
// line. No scope/exemption/dispatch decision is keyed here.
func renderLabel(v check.Violation) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("[%s] %s", v.Pass.String(), v.Message)
}
